name: KnowBe4
description:
This plugin is used to fetch Users from the 'Users > Manage Users' page of the KnowBe4 console. This plugin supports the 'Add User to Group', 'Remove User from Group', 'Enroll in Training' and 'Update Custom Field' actions on users in KnowBe4.

Netskope normalization score calculation for users => round(1000 - (KnowBe4's Risk Score x 10)), limited to the range 0 to 1000.

configuration.label: Base URL
configuration.description: Base URL of your KnowBe4 account, without a path. Do not include '/graphql'; the plugin appends it automatically. e.g. https://training.knowbe4.com. Select 'Custom Region URL' to provide a different endpoint below, e.g. for a new KnowBe4 deployment not yet listed here.

configuration.label: Custom Region URL
configuration.description: Base URL of your KnowBe4 tenant, without a path. Do not include '/graphql'; the plugin appends it automatically. Required only when 'Base URL' is set to 'Custom Region URL'. e.g. 'https://mytenant.knowbe4.com'.

configuration.label: KSAT API Token
configuration.description: API token of the KnowBe4 Security Awareness Training (KSAT) product. It can be generated from the 'Account Settings > Account Integrations > API > Product API > Create New API Token' page of the KnowBe4 console.

configuration.label: Pull Archived Users
configuration.description: Select 'Yes' to also pull archived users, in addition to active ones; the 'Archived' entity field is then available to map. Select 'No' to pull only active users.

configuration.label: Group Action Batch Size
configuration.description: Number of users sent in a single 'Add User to Group' or 'Remove User from Group' API call. Valid range: 1 to 100.

configuration.label: Pull Additional Details
configuration.description: Select the additional details to pull for each user.
